title: Render long capability lists on demand
goal: Reduce SwiftUI work when opening Skills, Memory, and Models by lazily creating rows in potentially long lists without changing data, ordering, actions, or persistence behavior.
context: PR #470 removed duplicate startup refresh and deferred model preparation to Chat. Follow-up inspection found Skills, Memory, and installed-model rows are rendered inside eager VStack containers even though the screens are hosted in scrolling surfaces. Use LazyVStack for these repeated rows so off-screen row views are created on demand. Chat already uses LazyVStack; workspace uses List and should remain unchanged.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Agent visual design, navigation, or row ordering.
Do not change model, Skill, Memory, persistence, or security contracts.
Do not claim measured performance gains without physical-device measurements.
Do not modify unrelated screens or add dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Skills rows are hosted by LazyVStack and preserve search, empty-state, and row content behavior.
Memory rows are hosted by LazyVStack and preserve filtering and forget actions.
Installed model rows are hosted by LazyVStack and preserve selection, deletion, and import behavior.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Physical-device performance remains unmeasured unless device evidence is collected.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Review the diff to verify only repeated-row container behavior changed.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if native build or row interactions regress; restore eager row containers only in the affected screen.
